title: Feature: Ancient Chinese astronomical instruments draw museum-goers to cosmic quest
description: HEFEI, Aug. 14 (Xinhua) -- China's museums are often defined by their porcelain, calligraphy and ritual vessels. But a new exhibition in east China's Anhui Province is turning the spotlight away from traditional treasures and toward scientific endeavors of the past, showcasing jade cosmograms, celestial star charts and bronze globes crafted by astronomers centuries ago. title: Pompeii remained frozen in time for nearly 1,700 years. It was discovered by a Spanish engineer looking for ancient treasures in 1748
description: The unearthing of Pompeii in 1748 unveiled a Roman city encased in volcanic ash, granting a unique glimpse into the lives and customs of ancient Romans. This archaeological marvel revealed residences, businesses, and artistic creations, offering profound insights into daily life. The eerie plaster casts of victims serve as a somber reminder of the tragedy that struck, enhancing our comprehension of ancient civilization.

title: 'The lance head was still inside the pelvis:' Mass grave found in Austria may hold casualties of unknown ancient Roman battle
description: A new analysis of skeletons recovered from an ancient mass burial has revealed a surprising number of groin injuries.
